US-Iran Tensions Escalate Amidst Strikes and Diplomatic Meetings

Following Iran's Revolutionary Guard striking two tankers in the Strait of Hormuz and Kuwait intercepting drones, the US responded with airstrikes on multiple Iranian locations. Reports indicate Iran launched missiles at a US base in Jordan. President Trump described his meetings with Ukrainian President Zelenskyy and Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu as 'very good,' while also stating Iran's missile and drone capabilities are significantly weakened and that the US would escalate attacks if necessary. Some coverage also mentioned a shipment of air defense missiles from China to Iran passing through Pakistan.
